🎯 𝗨𝗦𝗘 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗘: Saving and restoring tmux sessions with their full state, including running commands and environment, to quickly resume work without manual setup.
📅 Created: Feb 2026 • Updated: Oct 2026

⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃⁃

✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Save sessions (current, specific, or all) with detailed state including commands and scrollback.
✅ Lazy restore functionality to minimize RAM usage.
✅ Autosave daemon for periodic background snapshots.
✅ Interactive TUI browser with fuzzy search for sessions and windows.
✅ Keyboard-driven picker for session management.
✅ Lightweight picker mode for Alt-Tab-style switching.
✅ Integrations with AI coding assistants like Codex, Antex, and Claude.
✅ Flexible sorting options for sessions and windows.
✅ Optional fzf integration.
✅ Bootstrap restore on tmux startup.
✅ Full environment snapshots including pane layout and commands.
✅ Optional scrollback capture and replay.

Lazy-tmux is a Go-based CLI tool designed to efficiently manage and save tmux sessions. It allows users to preserve detailed session states, including windows, panes, layouts, running commands, and scrollback history, enabling lazy restoration of only necessary components to conserve resources.
